title: Reloading Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards — Register Quick Reference
content:
Only a card of a kind of Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards that is reloadable can be reloaded. Each reload is at least the kind's smallest issue or load, and the card's balance after the reload is never above the kind's largest balance after reloads. A reload is paid like a card purchase and earns no Finch Circle points. The card is in active status, as its system record shows before the reload.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judged on | Result when not met |
|---|---|---|
| The kind is reloadable | The card kind's reloadable term | The card is not reloaded |
| The card is in active status | The card's status on record | The card is not reloaded |
| The reload is at least the kind's smallest load | The amount of this reload | The card is not reloaded for that amount |
| The balance after the reload stays within the kind's largest balance after reloads | The card's balance on record plus this reload | The card is not reloaded for that amount |

Each row states a requirement of the rule; a reload proceeds only where all four are met.

## How a reload is treated

- It is paid for in the same way as a card purchase.
- It earns no Finch Circle points.
- It adds the amount reloaded to the balance of that card number.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cards)

- A hypothetical frozen card of a reloadable kind is not in active status and is not reloaded while frozen.
- A hypothetical card of a kind whose reloadable term is no is not reloaded, whatever its status and balance.
- A hypothetical active card of a reloadable kind whose balance already equals the kind's largest balance after reloads has no room for any reload.
